title: Lockup: New Mexico: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — Get Out and Stay Out
For some inmates, the only way out of prison is "paroling legit," or leaving in a body bag; others earn a lump sum of good time by completing programs or holding a prison job, while a few will take any chance to try to escape.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S6 E5 — The Little Things
Jail stays are getting longer and many inmates have very little, leading to violence erupting over any perceived slight, especially if it involves food.

title: Lockup: Tampa: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — Bitter Pills
An inmate with a long record runs an extortion scheme, while drugs inside the jail pose a lethal threat; the jail's newest team member makes her presence known.

title: Lockup: Tampa: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E2 — You Feel Me?
A drug-addicted mother asks a judge to keep her out of prison; just brought in on drug charges, a young man attempts to make bail, while another awaits sentencing for an unthinkable crime.

title: Lockup: Oakland: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E2 — Wait of the World
A violent gang member asks to move back to general population, following six years in segregation; a brother and sister are charged with murdering a high school football star, two years after he was stabbed to death on an Oakland street corner.

title: Lockup: Oakland: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — Permanent Scars
An inmate says a bet for two cups of soup led to a horrific slashing; a case of road rage results in a murder charge for a software engineer; after two years in jail, a jury will decide if he must go to prison for life.

title: Lockup: Indiana: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — "Old School" Convicts
A brutal stabbing puts Indiana State Prison on edge; a brash new inmate gets taken down a notch; two buddies do their time together; cameras are put into the hands of inmates who share intimate thoughts about life behind bars.

title: Lockup: Long Island: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — Sufferin' County
A female inmate finds romance with an alleged gang leader and the jailhouse prepares for a wedding; a very powerful inmate must make a choice between his crime family and his real family.

description:
